title: 如何复盘 Spotify 2025 年 Messages 首轮推出范围？
topic: 向客服和内容团队说明消息功能的用户需求、试点范围与现有渠道关系

source.title: Introducing Messages, A New Way To Share What You Love on Spotify with Friends and Family
source.type: Spotify 产品功能发布公告
source.context: 向客服和内容团队说明消息功能的用户需求、试点范围与现有渠道关系
paragraphs: Spotify users have told us they want a dedicated space within the app to share songs, podcasts, or audiobooks they’re excited about with friends and family, and an easy way to keep track of recommendations. For artists, authors, and creators, easier sharing means more word-of-mouth recommendations and helps create new fans. Our goal is to give users what they want and make those moments of connection more seamless and streamlined in the Spotify app.
That’s why, beginning this week, Messages will start rolling out to Free and Premium users in select markets on mobile devices. In order to access Messages, users must be aged 16 years and older.

As always, you should continue sharing Spotify content directly through your favorite platforms like Instagram, Facebook, WhatsApp, Snapchat, TikTok, and more. Messages on Spotify are designed to complement these integrations, not replace them, and we’re excited to continue offering more ways to drive hype for the Spotify content you love, wherever you are.
translations: Spotify 用户表示，他们希望在 App 内有一个专门空间，方便与亲友分享歌曲、播客和有声书，并跟踪收到的推荐。
因此，从本周开始，Spotify 将在部分市场的移动设备上向免费和 Premium 用户逐步推出 Messages；用户需年满 16 岁。
Spotify Messages 的设计目的是补充现有的分享渠道，而不是取代它们。
fullTextParagraphs: Recommendations have always been at the heart of the Spotify experience. Friends and family share their favorite music, podcasts, audiobooks, and more from Spotify millions of times each month. That’s because word of mouth is one of the most powerful ways for people to discover their next favorite track.

Spotify users have told us they want a dedicated space within the app to share songs, podcasts, or audiobooks they’re excited about with friends and family, and an easy way to keep track of recommendations. For artists, authors, and creators, easier sharing means more word-of-mouth recommendations and helps create new fans. Our goal is to give users what they want and make those moments of connection more seamless and streamlined in the Spotify app.
That’s why, beginning this week, Messages will start rolling out to Free and Premium users in select markets on mobile devices. In order to access Messages, users must be aged 16 years and older.

Whether you’re sharing a new audiobook with a friend for book club, bonding over your new favorite song, or swapping history podcasts with Dad, the right recommendation can spark a great conversation with those closest to you. Messages are a fast and convenient way to share and chat about what you’re listening to with the people you care about.

Messages also open up new opportunities for artists, authors, and creators—more users can spread the word about an artist’s track or creator’s podcast with their friends and family, helping drive discovery.
Messages are one-on-one conversations where you can share Spotify content and react with text and emojis.
Share Spotify content and start a message in-app with people you’ve interacted with before through Spotify.
When listening to a song, podcast, or audiobook in the Now Playing View, tap the share icon, select a friend, and hit send.

Once you accept a message request, you’ll be able to react with emojis, send texts, and seamlessly share Spotify content back and forth. Access Messages by going to your profile photo in the top left corner.

Messages are for the conversations you’re already having about music, podcasts and audiobooks with your friends and family. It’s easy to start a chat in the app with people you know and have previously shared Spotify content with. You’ll also see suggested people to message based on things like whether you’ve previously shared Spotify content with them, joined Jams, Blends, or collaborative playlists together, or if you share a Family or Duo plan.

As always, you should continue sharing Spotify content directly through your favorite platforms like Instagram, Facebook, WhatsApp, Snapchat, TikTok, and more. Messages on Spotify are designed to complement these integrations, not replace them, and we’re excited to continue offering more ways to drive hype for the Spotify content you love, wherever you are.

With Messages on Spotify, users are always in the driver’s seat. Users have the choice to accept or reject message requests from friends and family. Spotify’s Terms of Use and Platform Rules against illegal and harmful content still apply to Messages, so if something doesn’t feel right, you can easily report that content or account. You can report by holding down on the message in question, selecting “Report,” and choosing how the message violates our Terms of Use and/or Platform Rules. You are also able to block other users and opt out of Messages entirely through Settings.

To help ensure a secure sharing experience, conversations are protected with industry-standard encryption in transit and at rest. This means your data is protected by encryption when it’s stored and when it’s on the move. In keeping with our platform best practices, Spotify will utilize proactive detection technology to scan messages for certain unlawful and harmful content, and our moderators will review reported content. This two-pronged approach helps us offer a safer environment while respecting user privacy.
This is just the beginning. We’re excited to continue building and refining the experience for more Spotify users around the globe in the months ahead.

*Update as of January 28, 2026: We love all the feedback on Messages. That’s why, starting today, you can now share to a group through Spotify Messages. Share the podcasts, playlists, and audiobooks you’re listening to with up to 10 friends and family members per chat, and keep the conversation going directly on Spotify. The same user controls and safety functions for 1:1 messages are available for group chats. To learn more, check out the information below.

notes.phrase: users have told us they want a dedicated space
notes.meaning: 用户告诉我们，他们希望有一个专门的空间
notes.explain: have told us 用现在完成时，把此前收集的用户反馈连接到当前产品决定。
notes.example: Customers have told us they want clearer delivery updates.

notes.phrase: will start rolling out to Free and Premium users in select markets
notes.meaning: 将开始向部分市场的免费和 Premium 用户逐步推出
notes.explain: start rolling out 表示开始分批上线；select markets 限定首轮市场范围。
notes.example: The new booking tool will start rolling out to selected regions next week.

notes.phrase: designed to complement these integrations, not replace them
notes.meaning: 旨在补充这些现有渠道，而不是取代它们
notes.explain: complement 表示互相补充；不是把旧渠道撤掉。
notes.example: The new help center complements phone support rather than replacing it.

scenario.title: 虚构情境练习｜汇报购物 App 的商品分享功能
english: Users have asked for a simple way to share product lists with family inside a shopping app.
The team is rolling out shared lists to signed-in users in Australia and New Zealand this month.
The feature adds an in-app option while existing share links remain available. Write a short update for customer support.
chinese: 用户希望能在购物 App 内方便地与家人分享商品清单。
团队本月在澳大利亚和新西兰向已登录用户逐步推出共享清单。
这个功能新增了 App 内分享方式，原有分享链接仍可使用。请给客服团队写一段简短更新。

firstAttempt.prompt: 请根据 Spotify 于 2025 年 8 月 26 日的首发公告给客服和内容团队写三句话：说明用户需求、首轮推出对象与限制，以及新功能和原有分享渠道的关系。
firstAttempt.sample: In its August 2025 launch announcement, Spotify said users wanted a dedicated place in the app to share music, podcasts, and audiobooks. Messages was beginning to roll out to Free and Premium users aged 16 and older in select mobile markets. Spotify described Messages as a complement to existing sharing platforms, not a replacement.
firstAttempt.rationale: 按 2025 年 8 月的首发公告复盘需求、首轮范围和渠道关系；Spotify 官方页面于 2026 年 1 月另行更新了群聊功能，本课的首发公告不代表当前完整功能。

words.collocation: a dedicated space in the app
words.example: The app now has a dedicated space for shared lists.
words.translation: App 现在有一个专门放共享清单的区域。

words.collocation: roll out a feature to users
words.example: We will roll out the feature in three markets first.
words.translation: 我们会先在三个市场逐步推出这项功能。

words.example: The app keeps track of recommendations from friends.
words.translation: App 会记录朋友分享的推荐内容。

taskPhrases.word: users have told us they want
taskPhrases.meaning: 用户告诉我们，他们希望……
taskPhrases.collocation: users told us they want an easier way to...
taskPhrases.example: Users have told us they want an easier way to track delivery updates.
taskPhrases.translation: 用户告诉我们，他们希望更方便地跟踪配送更新。

taskPhrases.word: start rolling out to users in select markets
taskPhrases.meaning: 在部分市场开始分批推出
taskPhrases.collocation: start rolling out a feature to selected users
taskPhrases.example: In August 2025, Messages began rolling out to Free and Premium users aged 16 and older in select mobile markets.
taskPhrases.translation: 2025 年 8 月，Messages 开始向部分移动市场中年满 16 岁的 Free 和 Premium 用户逐步推出。

taskPhrases.word: complement existing channels, not replace them
taskPhrases.meaning: 补充现有渠道，而非取代它们
taskPhrases.collocation: a new service complements existing channels
taskPhrases.example: The in-app chat complements email support; it does not replace it.
taskPhrases.translation: App 内聊天补充邮件客服渠道，但不会取代邮件客服。

structure.original: That’s why, beginning this week, Messages will start rolling out to Free and Premium users in select markets on mobile devices.
analysis: beginning this week 插入句中，交代开始时间。
will start rolling out 描述分批开始上线；不是所有用户同时获得功能。
structure.transfer: Beginning next month, the new dashboard will start rolling out to store managers in selected regions.

rewrite.bad: The new feature is now available to everyone and replaces all other sharing apps.
rewrite.good: In its August 2025 launch announcement, Spotify said users wanted a dedicated place in the app to share music, podcasts, and audiobooks. Messages was beginning to roll out to Free and Premium users aged 16 and older in select mobile markets. Spotify described Messages as a complement to existing sharing platforms, not a replacement.
rewrite.translation: 在 2025 年 8 月的首发公告中，Spotify 表示，用户希望在 App 内有一个专门空间分享音乐、播客和有声书。Messages 当时开始向部分移动市场中年满 16 岁的 Free 和 Premium 用户逐步推出。Spotify 将 Messages 定位为对现有分享平台的补充，而不是替代。
rewrite.pattern: [users have told us they want] → [start rolling out to users in select markets] → [complement existing channels, not replace them]

choice.prompt: 按 Spotify 2025 年 8 月的首发公告，哪句准确保留了年龄、上线范围和渠道关系？
options: Messages replaced all external platforms for every Spotify user worldwide.
Messages began rolling out to users aged 16 and older in select mobile markets and complemented other sharing platforms.
Anyone under 16 could message anyone on Spotify.
choice.why: 第二句保留年满 16 岁、部分移动市场逐步推出和补充原有平台三项限定。
